login.permissionsHint: Grants read-only access to your skills, assets, wallet, mail, calendar, contracts, market orders, industry, clones, player structure names, planetary colonies, contacts and loyalty points. EVE's consent screen lists the planetary scope as "manage your planetary installations" — NeoCom Desk only reads that data and never writes to it. Log in again after an update to pick up newly requested permissions.

characters.deleteGroupConfirm: Delete this group? Its characters become ungrouped.

characters.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}}? This deletes their skill plans, build plans, quickbar and cached game data from this device, and — if a session can still be started as them — their synced plans, build plans, quickbar and settings too. If not, that remote data stays until you sign in as {{name}} again. This cannot be undone here.
characters.removeDeferredNotice: {{name}}'s synced data couldn't be cleared right now — their session couldn't be re-established. It will be cleared automatically the next time you sign in as {{name}}.
